title: Eaglebear Pebble Mini Velo
content:
The Eaglebear Pebble is a 20″ mini velo for all ages and mixed terrain riding, and is open for pre-order now ($999), with a February 2027 delivery. Hit the dirt path behind the neighborhood. Take the long way to get coffee. And when you get home, be it a walk-up apartment or the ‘burbs, it’ll take up a fraction of the space. One size fits riders 5′ 2″ to 6’ 4″.

Eaglebear is the team behind Prevelo, so they sweat the small stuff. The Pebble geometry fits grown-up bodies, parts that hold up when you ride it like you stole it, and a build quality that’ll make the Pebble the bike you grab first even when it isn’t the nicest one in the garage.

Check it out at Eaglebear.
